data.name: CIO (Confidential)
data.job_description_text:
Role: CIO

Context of the Role: Highly confidential replacement mandate
This is a mission-critical leadership role to strengthen and govern the company’s existing technology ecosystem. The organization has already invested significantly in digitisation across sales, distribution, manufacturing, and operations. The current need is execution, ownership, security, and control rather than fresh transformation.
Key drivers include:
  • Rising information and data security risks
  • Monitoring the efficiency of third-party applications (especially for Sales and Distributor Management)
  • Building a 3-year IT roadmap across Infrastructure, Applications, InfoSec, Data & AI, and strengthening a largely junior IT team.


Reporting to: Managing Director.
Team: Current IT team size is 12–14 members, largely junior with a few long-tenured employees. The CIO will be responsible for restructuring, capability building, and selective hiring.

Looking For:
A hands-on, execution-oriented IT leader comfortable in promoter-driven FMCG environments, with strong ownership and operational discipline. The individual should be a long-term stabilizer for the organization.

Role Requirements:
  • Applications & Digital Platforms: Own Sales and Distributor platforms (DMS & SFA – Field Assist), ensure adoption, compliance, uptime, and data accuracy across ~4,000 distributors and ~2,000 sales users, and enable seamless data flow between Sales, Operations, and Production.
  • Infrastructure & IT Operations: Review and stabilize existing infrastructure, improve monitoring of live but under-utilized systems, and strengthen vendor management and SLA governance.
  • Information Security & Risk: Strengthen data security, access controls, admin rights governance, third-party risk management, disaster recovery, backups, and incident readiness.
  • Data, Analytics & AI: Improve reporting and analytics maturity, establish data governance, and introduce AI/automation use cases in a phased manner.
  • Leadership & Governance: Establish IT governance, policies, and controls, and build a stronger internal IT team with leadership depth.


Education Background: No specific education requirement; practical experience and execution capability are prioritized.
Experience: Open. Candidates must have strong exposure to large field teams, distributor networks, third-party ecosystems, and execution-heavy IT operations and security environments.
Industry Background: FMCG, Consumer, Retail, and distribution-led organizations.
Target Companies: Indian FMCG and consumer brands, retail and distribution-heavy organizations, traditional or mid-scale enterprises.

Location: Chembur, Mumbai (office shifting to BKC by year-end)
Working Model: Work from office. Travel to factory locations in Gujarat and regional offices. All Saturdays are working half days.

Screening Process: Initial interaction with the MD (virtual or in-person) focusing on mindset, ownership, and execution capability. Final detailed discussion & decision by MD.

Search Strategy & Budgets:
  • Open to CIO or Head of IT as No.1 [We will prioritize this approach to begin with] || Budget: 80-1 Cr (all fixed)
  • Two -1 level heads each having expertise in Infra & Info-sec and Applications & Data respectively; both reporting into MD || Budget: 50-60 LPA (all fixed)


Documents to be shared with candidates: As discussed, we will be leveraging the 3-Year IT transformation plan (without the company logo) to be shared with candidates and also disclose the company name while emphasizing on a high level of confidentiality to be maintained.

1. Regional Head - CMS Sales (Commercial Banking)

Role/ Job Title: Regional Head - CMS Sales (Commercial Banking)

Function/ Department: Transaction Banking-Cash

Location: Delhi

Job Purpose:

The role entails owning the end to end & scaling Cash Management Business for the bank at regional level in a cost-effective manner. The role bearer is responsible for designing the sales strategy to build volumes across region in mid-corporate and pure liability clients. It includes building up teams, systems, process and culture amenable to the scale and consistency of delivery. The role will closely collaborate with the Product Head, Operations, Compliance, Risk, IT and Policy team to ensure development of a market leading solutions in CMS (Physical & Digital). The role is responsible for revenue growth and will develop strategies to drive product penetration while maintaining overall portfolio quality requirement. It has a direct revenue responsibility for the Cash Management business contributing to the larger organizational objectives of the bank.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Grow the volume of business for Cash Management solutions for mid-corporate and liability clients and ensure that the overall revenue, profitability and portfolio quality targets are met.
  • Lead and direct the team by providing strategic inputs and plans for distribution penetration in current markets as well as future geographic expansion.
  • Develop constructive relationships with key partners to drive growth of business.
  • Collaborate with the Product Head and policies team to ensure that the target segment is offered the best in class & customized CMS solutions.
  • Design long term and short term strategy and develop constructive relationships with Digital marketplace partners and key alliances to drive digital transactions.
  • Conduct competition benchmarking and gather market intelligence to shape up the overall sales & product strategy for maximizing business growth.
  • Design a fulfilling customer journey leading to customer delight and making IDFC First Bank their banking partner of choice.
  • Leverage synergies through collaboration with internal stakeholders and deepen relationship with customers.
  • Ensure the successful adoption of internal compliances and regulatory framework across the business.
  • Maximize average current account balance and fee income.
  • Champion the adoption of high-quality market intelligence and data analytics to promote product, solution and sales effectiveness in line with the banks growth/profitability objectives.
  • Recommend improvements to processes and policies across the Cash Management business to drive operational efficiencies and high quality customer service.
  • Keep abreast with global market trends and competitor strategies in key markets.
  • Monitor key parameters on sales productivity, hiring quality and attrition rates and make necessary improvements.
  • Champion IDFC FIRST's customer first culture by driving the team to take up high degree servicing norms to ensure absolute customer delight.
  • Attract and retain best-in-class talent for key roles in their reporting structure.
  • Drive co-operation with product, technology, analytics and risk teams to ensure smooth functioning of business.
  • Ensure that sales team adhere to benchmarks/processes set up for finalizing commercials and other key parameters.

Education Qualification:

Graduate – Any graduation

Post Graduate – Any post graduation

Experience: 10+ years of experience with 3+ years at leadership position in Transaction Banking

  • Guiding and mentoring team to achieve overall goals and objectives of Trade Business.
  • Work closely with Business Head and provide timely inputs on improving efficiencies.

10+ years of experience with 3+ years at leadership position in Transaction Banking
